skill.name: A professional skill for reading electronic datasheets

instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.
Use when user has/is reading a component datasheet or spec sheet to find chip parameters: pinout, voltage, I2C address, timing, register map, electrical char...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ee-datasheet-master skill.
- Designed for extracting precise electronic component parameters directly from datasheets/spec sheets.
- Enforces PDF-only sourcing: all data must originate from the provided PDF, no prior/model-based knowledge allowed.
- Provides step-by-step workflow for parameter extraction, missing-info handling, and edge-case reasoning.
- Includes detailed instructions, command-line extraction examples, and standardized output templates for clear, source-cited results.
